responsibility: Declares the small runtime interface that enables preemptive scheduling for the Processes subsystem. Its single procedure configures a timer quantum in seconds and microseconds, switching the cooperative process runtime into a timer-driven scheduling mode when requested.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is only the public declaration for the Preemptive pair, exposing the single initPreemptive entry point; the companion Preemptive.mod contains the timer process, RTint vector setup/rearming, and scheduler interaction with Processes needed to realize preemptive behavior.
